tip.text: Hey... Hey you! You wanna buy some awesomeness?
Wait... you aint a cop are ya!? You willing to prove it!?
You look quick. You know you can press left or right to run right? Try it!
Tap this circle to slash with that sweet sword of yours. Tapping multiple times quickly will do a combo. Try it out.
Prove you aint no cop! Take out these evil apples! Don't let them touch you!
Nice! Nothin better then the smell of exploding evil food in the morning.
You got some powerful robo legs don'tcha? Slide your finger on this circle to jump in any direction.
Try a double jump by swiping your finger a 2nd time after you are already airborn.
When there are enemies in range, instead of jumping, sliding your finger towards them will perform a super-slash!
Slide your finger towards these fools to waste them!
Haha! You aint no cop that's for sure. I'll hook you up with some Ninja Stars, on-the-house.
Press anywhere to throw a Ninja Star in that direction. Hold your finger down to keep throwing.
Good! Aw snap- evil banana's incoming. Take them out with your Ninja Stars!
Nicely done! Well that's all I- Uh oh... A big group of evil nastiness is incoming!
Crap, it looks too difficult for the tutorial! I'm outta here! Put what you learned together to take them out!
Sweet! Hoptron you're one cool bot. I'll be sure to come back with the 'good stuff' later. Gather up some loot, my products aint cheap!

extratip.text: Looks like more are coming. Try to take them out using a super slash instead. Slide your finger in the direction you want to slash.
More are coming. Take them out using your Ninja Stars instead. Just press your finger on their stupid faces!
You're looking a little wrecked Hoptron. Fix yourself up with this health potion, my treat.
